What is Dragonborn?

Dragonborn belongs to The Elder Scrolls.

It is the fifth main installment in The Elder Scrolls series, following The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion (2006), and was released worldwide for Windows, PlayStation 3, and Xbox 360 on November 11, 2011.

Also known as: Dovahkiin, Last Dragonborn.
